messages:
marta: Heads up — customer acme reported SCIM 403s on bulk provisioning after last night's KMS alias rotation. Audit shows 'envelope header alias mismatch' for a subset of wrapped keys. Anyone seen this before?
kevin: I have the raw logs. Looks like some wrapped keys still reference the old alias and fail unwrap. @ria can you check the rekey job status and failures?
ria: Checking now. Rekey job ran ~2026-03-15T02:13Z. I see ~1200 successful unwraps then a flurry of 500s from kms-proxy. Sample log:
```
ERROR scim-provisioner: unwrap failed tenant=acme user=svc-batch-01 err="envelope header alias mismatch: expected projects/.../aliases/redwood-svc-key, got projects/.../aliases/redwood-svc-key-v2"
```
kms-rotations: rotation-complete: alias 'projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/redwood-svc-key-v2' created and set as primary at 2026-03-15T02:12:47Z
sam: Could this be tied to our RBAC change last week? I see deprovision events for two SSO-linked service accounts around the same time. If extId decrypt fails, SCIM fallback matching might consider them orphaned.
marta: That's my worry — SCIM treats missing extId as absent identity and our current mapping falls back to email matching which in some cases triggers deprov flows. We need to pause deprovs until unwrap stabilized.
kevin: Proposed immediate actions: re-add the old alias to key policy (so unwrap agents can still access it), requeue unwrap backfills, and pause any automatic deprovisioning. Also planning a one-off retry: `python tools/kms_unwrap_retry.py --tenant acme --limit 500`
ria: I kicked off the retry on staging. 200 succeeded, 3 failed with a different error: 'jwe: unsupported header param typ'. Example JWE header snippet (redacted): `{"alg":"RSA-OAEP","enc":"A256GCM","typ":"JWT"}` — looks like some clients wrote a non-standard typ.
sam: That explains the duplication bug I found: when extId is null we run idempotency on email+name and in certain okta mappings that led to duplicate entitlements being created. We'll need to patch the idempotency key to include provisioning_source and extId presence.
marta: Oncall — can you pause SCIM webhooks and flip the feature flag that auto-deprovs on missing extId? We should avoid causing more customer churn while we fix unwraps. @tara
tara: Done. Paused scim webhook delivery queue for tenant acme and flipped `scim-deprov-on-missing-extid=false` for that tenant. Also raised provisioner log level to DEBUG.
kevin: Next steps (short):
1) re-add old alias and replication until unwraps finish
2) run backfill unwrap job across affected tenants
3) run backfill to populate scim_extid for affected svc accounts (non-destructive)
4) patch idempotency key to avoid duplicate entitlements when extId missing
5) customer comms + postmortem
ria: I have a backfill script ready: `./scripts/backfill_extid.sh acme /tmp/acme-affected.csv` — will run once old alias is reintroduced. I already exported affected user list to /tmp/acme-affected.csv (approx 42 rows).
marta: Assigning @kevin and @ria to lead the fix. I'll draft the customer message and coordinate with support. ETA aiming for restoration within 2 hours, will update here.
tara: Noted. I've also gated retries for background workers so we don't hammer KMS.
sam: Small addendum: add a validation check in the rekeyer to ensure header.typ is one of our accepted set before promoting. That'll catch the 'typ' mismatch ria saw.
marta: Great catch. I'll include that in the rollout checklist. :thumbsup: keep updates here and ping me for any blocker.
